@snapflow/api-client/svelte-query.message: Only lib/api talks to the backend: add a query or mutation options function to lib/api/<domain>.ts and import that.

#lib/api/auth/client.ts.message: Only lib/api talks to the backend: call an auth function from lib/api/auth/ instead of the raw auth client.

patterns.message: API files hold server access only: return API data and let components, routes or features own UI concerns. Toasts go through MutationCache meta in api/client/query-client.ts.
The MutationCache bridge may only use the toast store from lib/components.
API files must not import lib/features.
